definitions.explanation: Differences or variations between individuals. Commonly used when noting that results, effects, or experiences may vary from person to person.

examples.japanese: {効果|こうか}には{個人差|こじんさ}があります。
{薬|くすり}の{効|き}き{目|め}には{個人差|こじんさ}が{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: The effectiveness of the medicine varies greatly between individuals.

examples.japanese: {成長|せいちょう}のスピードには{個人差|こじんさ}があるので、{他|ほか}の{子|こ}と{比|くら}べなくてもいい。
examples.english: The speed of growth varies between individuals, so there's no need to compare with other children.

notes:
A very common phrase in medical, health, and product contexts. The standard disclaimer {個人差|こじんさ}があります ("individual results may vary") appears frequently in advertisements, medical explanations, and product descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個人差|こじんさ}がある (there are individual differences)
- {個人差|こじんさ}が{大|おお}きい (there is great individual variation)
- {個人差|こじんさ}を{考慮|こうりょ}する (take individual differences into account)

The word is composed of {個人|こじん} (individual) + {差|さ} (difference). Similar compound words include {年齢差|ねんれいさ} (age difference) and {格差|かくさ} (disparity).
